title: Canonical adapter text must not carry a machine-specific checkout path
observation: adapters/global/AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/personal-agent-os/SKILL.md hard-coded an absolute user path under Projects/Personal Agent, which is both machine-specific and stale: the real checkout is under GitHub/personal-agent-os. A clone on another computer would instruct the agent to run a path that does not exist.
evidence: grep found 5 hard-coded occurrences across the two canonical adapters
validate warned that the installed codex SKILL.md differed from canonical source
suggested_direction: Keep an AGENT_OS_REPOSITORY placeholder in canonical Git text and render it to the resolved checkout at install time, so installed copies stay concrete while Git stays portable.
acceptance: No canonical adapter contains an absolute user path.
Rendering resolves the placeholder to the current checkout.
routing-status reports no drift for a rendered install.
